d: Are you passionate about football (soccer) and interested in growing a local football community?
Stranger Soccer is expanding globally and is looking for an Operator & License Owner to launch, manage, and grow our football platform in Kuwait City.

This is not a conventional management job—it's an opportunity to build and operate your own local football operation while making football more accessible in your city. It's ideal for entrepreneurial individuals who are passionate about the game and driven to create meaningful, lasting impact.
As an Operator & License Owner, you'll lead the growth of Stranger Soccer in Kuwait City—from building local partnerships and managing operations to growing an active community of players.
You'll have the freedom to shape the local operation while benefiting from the systems, expertise, and support of our Singapore headquarters.
q: Passion for football and a strong understanding of the local football community
An entrepreneurial mindset with a strong sense of ownership
Experience managing operations and delivering measurable results
Background in operations, community management, or customer experience
Strong leadership, communication, and relationship-building skills
Build and grow Stranger Soccer in your city
Make a lasting impact on the local football community
Lead a growing network of players and Official Hosts
Benefit from the support of an established international brand
Enjoy a performance-driven opportunity where your success drives your rewards
Stranger Soccer makes playing football simple, flexible, and accessible. Through our mobile app, players can discover nearby games, book a spot, and simply turn up to play.

Founded in Singapore, Stranger Soccer now operates in 10+ cities worldwide and has hosted over 100,000 games. We're looking for passionate individuals who want to bring this experience to their local communities.
Visit www.strangersoccer.com and explore the "Bring Stranger Soccer to Your City" section to learn more.
If you're excited to help shape the future of football participation, we'd love to hear from you.
r: Launch and grow Stranger Soccer in Kuwait City
Build partnerships with football venues and secure quality playing locations
Recruit, coordinate, and support Official Hosts and local team members
Drive marketing initiatives to attract players and grow the community
Oversee game operations and deliver an outstanding player experience
Identify opportunities to improve and expand the local operation
You'll receive support from our Singapore headquarters, including
A technology platform for app, payments, and operations
Ongoing guidance across operations, marketing, and growth

d: SRT Marine Systems plc (SRT) are a market leader in its domain of international marine surveillance technology and systems. We are respected, established and an ambitious multi-national company headquartered in the UK with a global customer base.

The company has a global impact in the marine domain by leading the next generation of Maritime Domain Awareness 'MDA' technologies, products and systems that significantly enhance, security, safety and environment protection and sustainability. Our customers are worldwide and range from the largest national coast guards to individual vessel owners.

SRT is an exciting company where high-quality results are rewarded. We are ambitious and are constantly seeking to innovate to deliver better products and services to our customers. We strive to make SRT a rewarding and challenging place to work where talented hard-working individuals have the opportunity to make a real impact across the marine world.

You as our Senior Construction Director will work on SRT projects in the Middle East region. This is an extremely hands-on, site-facing role supporting the Programme Director by leading project delivery, coordinating assigned workstreams, and controlling delivery against agreed scope, schedule, cost, quality, risk and customer commitments.
Role Overview of our Senior Construction Director

The Senior Construction Director will coordinate ICP, design consultants, subcontractors and internal SRT teams through design development, construction readiness, installation and acceptance. The role will also act as design manager/coordinator during design development, overseeing the ICP design consultant and managing design reviews, comment close-out, approvals and alignment with SRT technical requirements, customer obligations and site delivery constraints. This is an extremely "Hands-on" role and the expectation is for a majority of time to be spent on each of our project sites.
q: Strong, proven experience in project management and delivery of complex construction and system integration projects, including construction delivery interfaces on complex multi-site programmes
Experience of civil build, construction and design for communication towers, data centres etc. would prove highly beneficial
Experience of international build, construction and design knowledge would prove highly beneficial

Experience working with in-country partners, design consultants, customer-side stakeholders, government/regulatory stakeholders and local subcontractors in the Middle East or comparable international delivery environments
Ability to review and challenge contractor programmes, identify schedule risk, support recovery planning and translate programme issues into practical site actions
Strong capability in managing design clarifications, technical deviations, approval dependencies, procurement interfaces and installation-readiness constraints

Experience acting as a design manager, design coordinator or client-side design lead, including management of consultant deliverables, design review trackers, technical queries, comment close-out and approval workflows
Strong working knowledge of project governance, integrated planning, RAID management, change control, progress reporting, stakeholder management and commercial delivery awareness

Experience supporting a Programme Director or equivalent senior delivery leader by consolidating delivery reporting, escalating risks and ensuring project execution remains aligned to programme objectives
Comfortable operating in an extremely hands-on, site-based capacity, with the flexibility to travel regularly across Middle East for extended periods as project delivery requires
IT Literate (Microsoft Word, Microsoft Excel, Project Schedule software including P6 and MSP, CAD)
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to adjust communication style to suit customers, partners and internal teams
